BAD_REQUEST.title: Invalid request
BAD_REQUEST.description: Refresh the page and try again.

FORBIDDEN.title: Access denied
FORBIDDEN.description: This section is not available for your account.

MFA_REQUIRED.title: Verify sign-in
MFA_REQUIRED.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED.title: Enable two-factor authentication
MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED.description: This is required to access your data.

TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED.title: The terms of use have changed
TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED.description: Read the changes and confirm to continue.

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.title: Confirm this operation
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

PAT_SCOPE_MISSING.title: Token lacks permission
PAT_SCOPE_MISSING.description: Create a token with the scope required by this operation.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.description: The item does not exist or you do not have access to it.

CONFLICT.title: Data has changed
CONFLICT.description: Refresh the view and repeat the change.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.title: Repeated request
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: This request has already been sent with different content.

INSTRUMENT_AMBIGUOUS.title: More than one instrument
INSTRUMENT_AMBIGUOUS.description: Choose the correct instrument from the list.

DUPLICATE_IMPORT.title: This file has already been imported
DUPLICATE_IMPORT.description: Open the previous import or select a different file.

RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.title: Reconcile the data first
RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.description: Account balances do not match the transactions.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.title: Unsupported file type
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Upload an XLSX or CSV file.

IMPORT_FORMAT_UNKNOWN.title: Unrecognized format
IMPORT_FORMAT_UNKNOWN.description: Check that this is a full export from XTB or mBank.

VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Correct the highlighted fields
VALIDATION_FAILED.description: Details are shown next to the form fields.

PARAMETERS_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.title: Parameters outside the allowed range
PARAMETERS_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.description: Reduce the range or number of variants.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Daily limit reached
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: Further analyses will be available tomorrow.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong
INTERNAL.description: Try again. If the error returns, provide request ID {requestId}.
